info.title: ElevenLabs Realtime Text to Dialogue
info.description:
Stream expressive dialogue audio over a WebSocket by sending incremental text segments per registered voice.

The connection uses Eleven v3 dialogue models only (`model_id` must start with `eleven_v3`). The default model is `eleven_v3_conversational`.

## Session setup
- After connecting, the first JSON message **must** include `voices` (voice IDs to register for the session) and credentials if not already sent via headers or query string.
- Optional `voice_settings` and `pronunciation_dictionary_locators` are only accepted on the first message.
- For `eleven_v3_conversational`, only **one** voice ID may be registered. For `eleven_v3`, you may register up to **10** voices.

## Streaming text
- Send `inputs`: an array of `{ "text", "voice_id", "new_turn"? }`. Text for the same turn is buffered until the server has enough context (at least ~40 characters and 8 words), then partial audio chunks are emitted.
- Set `new_turn` to `true` (or switch `voice_id`) to finalize the current prosody segment and start a new speaker turn.

## Control messages
- `flush`: force generation of any buffered text without closing the socket.
- `close_socket`: flush remaining audio, send a final message, and close the connection.
- `keep_alive`: reset the **20 second** receive timeout (no generation).

## Authentication
Use the `xi-api-key` or `Authorization` header, `single_use_token` query parameter, or include `xi_api_key`, `authorization`, or `single_use_token` in the first message body (same pattern as [Text to Speech WebSocket](/docs/api-reference/text-to-speech/v-1-text-to-speech-voice-id-stream-input)). Anonymous sessions are rejected.

For non-streaming dialogue over HTTP, see [Create dialogue](/docs/api-reference/text-to-dialogue/convert) and [Stream dialogue](/docs/api-reference/text-to-dialogue/stream).

sendDialogueMessage.summary: Send dialogue text or a control message.

DialogueTextAlignment.description: Character-level alignment data (field names use snake_case in JSON).
DialogueTextAlignment.title: DialogueTextAlignment

audio.description: Base64-encoded audio bytes for the selected `output_format`.

alignment.description: Present when sync_alignment is true and timing data is available.

normalized_alignment.description: Reserved for future use; currently unused by the server.

TextToDialogueWebsocketAudioChunk.description: Server chunk containing encoded audio and optional alignment metadata.
TextToDialogueWebsocketAudioChunk.title: TextToDialogueWebsocketAudioChunk

is_final_audio_for_turn.description: Indicates that the final audio for a given turn has been sent.

is_final.description: Marks the end of the closing flush sequence.

code.description: WebSocket close code that will follow this payload.

param.description: Field name related to the error, when applicable.

text.description: Text appended for this voice. Buffered with prior text until the server triggers generation.

voice_id.description: Must be one of the IDs from the initial `voices` array.

new_turn.description: When `true`, the server finalizes the current pending segment (as if the speaker finished their turn) before applying this input.

stability.description: Determines how stable the voice is and the randomness between each generation. Lower values introduce broader emotional range for the voice. Higher values can result in a monotonous voice with limited emotion.

TextToDialogueWebsocketVoiceSettings.description: Voice settings for dialogue generation. Only `stability` is supported for `eleven_v3` dialogue models.
TextToDialogueWebsocketVoiceSettings.title: TextToDialogueWebsocketVoiceSettings

pronunciation_dictionary_id.description: The unique identifier of the pronunciation dictionary

version_id.description: The version identifier of the pronunciation dictionary

PronunciationDictionaryLocator.description: Identifies a specific pronunciation dictionary to use
PronunciationDictionaryLocator.title: PronunciationDictionaryLocator

inputs.description: Dialogue lines to append for synthesis.

flush.description: Force generation of buffered text without closing the connection.

close_socket.description: Flush buffers, emit remaining audio, send `is_final`, and close the WebSocket.

keep_alive.description: Resets the 20s inactivity timer; performs no synthesis.

xi_api_key.description: API key for the first message if not provided via the `xi-api-key` header.

authorization.description: Bearer token for the first message if not provided via the `Authorization` header.

single_use_token.description: Single-use token for the first message if not provided via the `single_use_token` query parameter.

voices.description: Voice IDs to load for the session (first message only, required on first message).

TextToDialogueWebsocketClientMessage.description:
All fields are optional unless noted for the **first** message.

**First message requirements**
- `voices`: non-empty array of voice IDs (maximum 10 for `eleven_v3`; exactly 1 for `eleven_v3_conversational`).
- Credentials if not supplied via `xi-api-key` / `Authorization` headers or `single_use_token` query parameter.

**Subsequent messages**
- Do not resend `voices`, `pronunciation_dictionary_locators`, or credential fields.
